whenToUse.travel.entry-requirements-check: Use when someone asks whether they need a visa, eTA or transit visa, or how long their passport must be valid, or plans any international trip; check each traveller's nationality, residence and route.
whenToUse.learn.conversation-practice: Use when a learner wants to practise speaking or chatting, by text or voice, or answers in the target language inside a practice conversation or role-play.
whenToUse.fitness.readiness-screen: Use when someone is about to get their first training plan, or comes back to training after an injury, illness, surgery, pregnancy or a long break. Not for a new ache mid-programme.
whenToUse.ps.purchase-issues: Use when a player reports being charged without receiving items, losing purchases after a reinstall, a double charge, or asks for a refund, including what to reply to them.
